entries.title: Isaiah 32:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The blessings of Christ's kingdom. 9 Desolation is foreshewn. 15 Restoration is promised to succeed.

king. 9:6,7; 40:1-5; 2Sa 23:3; 2Ch 31:20,21; Ps 45:1,6,7; 72:1,2; 99:4 Jer 23:5,6; 33:15; Ho 3:5; Zec 9:9; Ro 5:21; Heb 1:8,9; Re 19:11 princes. 28:6; Re 17:14

entries.title: Isaiah 32:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: heart. 29:24; Ne 8:8-12; Mt 11:25; 16:17; Ac 6:7; 26:9-11; Ga 1:23 rash. Heb. hasty. the tongue. Ex 4:11; So 7:9; Lu 21:14,15; Ac 2:4-12; 4:13 plainly. or, elegantly.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:7
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: instruments. 1:23; 5:23; Jer 5:26-28; Mic 2:11; 7:3; Mt 26:14-16,59,60 deviseth. Ps 10:7-10; 64:4-6; 82:2-5; Jer 18:18; Mic 7:2; Mt 26:4 lying. 59:3,4; 1Ki 21:10-14; Ac 6:11-13 the needy speaketh right. or, he speaketh against the poorin judgment.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:8
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the liberal. 2Sa 9:1-13; Job 31:16-21; Ps 112:9; Pr 11:24; Lu 6:33-35; Ac 9:39 Ac 11:29,30; 2Co 8:2; 9:6-11 stand. or, be established.

entries.title: Isaiah 32:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Many days and years. Heb. Days above a year. 3:17-26; 24:7-12; Jer 25:10,11; Ho 3:4 for. 7:23; 16:10; Jer 8:13; Ho 2:12; Joe 1:7,12; Hab 3:17; Zep 1:13

entries.title: Isaiah 32:12
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: lament. La 2:11; 4:3,4 pleasant fields. Heb. fields of desire. De 8:7,8; 11:11,12; Eze 20:6,15

entries.title: Isaiah 32:13
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: come. 6:11; 7:23; 34:13; Ps 107:34; Ho 9:6; 10:8 yea, upon. or, burning upon, etc. Jer 39:8; Re 18:7,8 in the. 22:2,12,13

entries.title: Isaiah 32:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the palaces. 5:9; 24:1-3,10,12; 25:2; 27:10; 2Ki 25:9; Lu 21:20,24 forts and towers. or, clifts and watch-towers. for. 13:19-22; 34:11-17; Re 18:2,3

entries.title: Isaiah 32:19
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: it shall. 25:4; 28:2,17; 30:30; 37:24; Ex 9:18-26; Eze 13:11-13; Mt 7:25 Re 8:7 on the. Zec 11:2 the city shall be low. or, the city shall be utterly abased. 14:22,23; 26:5; Na 1:1,8; 2:10-13; Re 18:21
